add.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia; Mexico/CDMX section)
add.summary: Thin: Wikipedia's 'LGBTQ people in prison' article, Mexico section (accessed 4 Oct 2026), documents only one Mexico City prison-system policy: in July 2007, through the efforts of the (capital's) National Human Rights Commission (CDHDF), the Mexico City prison system began allowing same-sex conjugal visits on the basis of a 2003 law banning discrimination based on sexual orientation, with the visitor not required to be married to the inmate and the change applying to all Mexico City prisons. The article contains no data on trans-prisoner housing placement in Mexico City (birth-sex vs identity placement), special units, or segregation practice; the country-level MEX record carries the same finding.
